name: mould_cavity
description: Injection-mould cavity insert 90 x 70 x 30. Elliptical cavity 70 x 50 at the top face, drafted down to a 50 x 30 floor at 14 mm depth (lofted walls), R4 blended floor edge, a spherical dome (R30) rising 6 mm from the floor in the middle. 2 mm x 45deg chamfer around the cavity rim. Four D8 guide-pin holes 12 deep near the corners.
